title: Prologue to Ambrose: praying the twentieth tome from the Son’s fullness
english: As we dictate the twentieth tome on the Gospel according to John, most God-loving and most studious Ambrose in the Lord, we pray to receive full thoughts from [[the fullness of the Son of God, in whom it pleased all the fullness to dwell. >> Bible:Colossians 1:19]]
May God therefore send us the Word himself, making himself manifest, so that we may become beholders of his depth, the Father granting it.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: “I know you are Abraham’s seed” vs “If you were Abraham’s children”
english: [[“I know that you are Abraham’s seed; but you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.” >> Bible:John 8:37]]

To those who do not distinguish the senses of “seed” and “child,” [[“I know you are Abraham’s seed” >> Bible:John 8:37]] will seem to clash with [[“If you are Abraham’s children, do the works of Abraham.” >> Bible:John 8:39]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Bodily difference of seed and child
english: So that this may be seen, let us first look bodily at the difference of seed and child. Clearly a seed holds the reasons of the sower still quiet and stored within it.
But a child comes to be when the seed has changed and worked the matter around it, having been formed and made ready for birth.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Raising seed and child from bodies to souls
english: Let us hear all this by referring what is said not to bodies and bodily humans, but to souls and the dispositions in them.
For there is in a soul both Abraham’s seed and Abraham’s child; and not everyone who has the seed has already become a child.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: My word finds no place in you
english: [[“But you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.” >> Bible:John 8:37]]
For the word to “find place” in someone is for him to receive it into the ruling faculty and become capacious of the thoughts of truth.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Those who cannot contain the word
english: Those addressed seem not to contain the word, which cannot enter them because of vice.
As narrow vessels do not contain much wine, so a soul filled with desires does not contain the word.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: What I have seen with the Father I speak
english: [[“What I have seen with the Father I speak; and you, then, do what you have heard from the Father.” >> Bible:John 8:38]]
Ask in what way the Son has seen with the Father, and how those addressed hear from the Father.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Against those who introduce natures
english: We would ask those who introduce natures how those who are children of the devil by nature are blamed as able to live otherwise.
If they are such by nature, they are rebuked in vain; if they are rebuked, they are such not by nature but by choice.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: If you are Abraham’s children, do Abraham’s works
english: They answered, [[“Our father is Abraham.” >> Bible:John 8:39]] Jesus said to them, [[“If you are Abraham’s children, do the works of Abraham.” >> Bible:John 8:39]]
Saying “Our father is Abraham” does not make children; doing Abraham’s works does.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Abraham’s works: he believed God
english: Those who pick out one of Abraham’s works — [[“Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness” >> Bible:Genesis 15:6]] — choose well.
Yet one must also seek the rest: departure from his land, offering of the son, hospitality, so that we may become Abraham’s children.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: This Abraham did not do
english: [[“But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God; this Abraham did not do.” >> Bible:John 8:40]]
It is a great thing not to do what Abraham did not do, and to do what he did. Those who seek to kill the one who speaks the truth are not Abraham’s children.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You do the works of your father
english: You say, [[“We were not born of fornication; we have one Father, God.” >> Bible:John 8:41]] Jesus said, [[“If God were your Father, you would love me.” >> Bible:John 8:42]]
[[“You do the works of your father” >> Bible:John 8:41]] shows another father, whose works they seek to imitate.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: I came from God and I am here
english: [[“For I came from God and I am here; for I have not come of myself, but he sent me.” >> Bible:John 8:42]]
“Coming from God” is to be taken in a God-befitting way: not a change of place, but the Word’s generation from the Father.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Why do you not understand my speech?
english: [[“Why do you not understand my speech? Because you cannot hear my word.” >> Bible:John 8:43]]
Speech and word differ: speech is ready to hand, the word deeper. Those who cannot contain the word do not even understand the speech.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You are of your father the devil
english: [[“You are of your father the devil, and you want to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
Some become children of the devil not by nature but by imitation and choice, doing his desires.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: He does not stand in the truth
english: [[“And he does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks the lie, he speaks from his own, for he is a liar and the father of it.” >> Bible:John 8:44]]
The lie is the devil’s own. Christ is the truth, and [[whoever is of the truth hears his voice. >> Bible:John 18:37]]
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: Because I speak the truth, you do not believe me
english: [[“But because I speak the truth, you do not believe me. Which of you convicts me concerning sin?” >> Bible:John 8:45-46]]
It is paradoxical that speaking the truth is the cause of unbelief; yet to lovers of lies the truth is distasteful.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: The one of God hears God’s words
english: [[“The one who is of God hears the words of God; for this reason you do not hear, because you are not of God.” >> Bible:John 8:47]]
The criterion of being of God is hearing God’s words; those who do not hear convict themselves.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: You have a demon; I do not have a demon
english: The Jews answered, [[“Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?” >> Bible:John 8:48]] Jesus answered, [[“I do not have a demon, but I honor my Father.” >> Bible:John 8:49]]
Those who blaspheme the Word call him Samaritan and demon-possessed; but the one who honors the Father does not have a demon.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.

title: If anyone keeps my word, he will not see death forever
english: [[“Truly, truly, I say to you, if anyone keeps my word, he will never see death.” >> Bible:John 8:51]]
The cause of their not knowing his meaning is not keeping the word; the one who keeps it does not see eternal death.
translator_notes: OET. Pass A!=B. Heine not wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.
